digest.component_or_area: live DC harness and reconciler rich-text integration
propositions: Live rendered HTML must be asserted via ?expand=renderedFields (not wiki source) to verify Jira's interpretation of bold/heading/code-macro markup
State-based echo-safety across a second reconcile pass must emit no description re-push after a converged baseline
Both-sides concurrent edit (rebar-side AND Jira-side description change before next pass) must keep local value and emit deduped outbound-field-conflict alert with remote value preserved
normalize_rich_text public signature and behavior must be pinned by a cross-repo contract test so breaking changes fail before import in agentic-dev-platform
DC cutover must be enabled (REBAR_RECONCILER_RICH_TEXT_CUTOVER) for live tests to exercise Markdown->wiki conversion and verify codec fidelity against real renderer
